key.name: database-path
key.description: Path to Planify's database.db. When empty, the extension probes the standard native (~/.local/share/io.github.alainm23.planify/) and Flatpak (~/.var/app/...) locations. Useful for testing.

key.name: max-rows
key.description: Maximum number of task rows rendered in the popup before it scrolls.

key.name: animation-duration
key.summary: Popup open animation duration in ms
key.description: 0 uses the built-in duration (220 ms open / 160 ms close). Mainly useful for testing and reduced-motion environments.

key.name: complete-delay-seconds
key.summary: Undo window for completions, in seconds
key.description: After clicking a task's checkbox, wait this many seconds before actually completing it; clicking the checkbox again during the window cancels. 0 completes immediately.

key.name: badge-mode
key.description: "count" shows the open-task number, "dot" a colored dot, "hidden" nothing.

key.name: debug-dbus
key.description: When enabled, owns io.github.alainm23.planify.QuickView on the session bus with Toggle/Open/Close/Status/Capture methods for automated testing. Keep off in daily use.

key.name: toggle-quick-view
key.summary: Global keybinding to toggle the quick view
key.description: Keyboard shortcut that opens or closes the quick-view popup, e.g. ['<Super><Shift>p'].
